responsibility: Implements the Rust typechecker’s on-demand type query helper. query_type consults TypeCheckContext for an already resolved TyTy node, guards against recursive queries, and otherwise dispatches to the appropriate item, impl-item, impl-self, or extern-item resolver based on HIR mappings, making lazy type lookup available to path probing, method resolution, and trait-bound analysis.
same_name_distinction: Implements the lazy query_type dispatcher for this stem, including recursion guarding and branching to item, impl-item, impl-self, and extern-item resolvers; the .h file only publishes the query_type entry point.
